features.text: GONIOMETER HINGED WRIST: Adjustable hinge allows precise control of wrist angle for therapeutic stretching.
AIR CONE DESIGN: Gently opens a fisted hand using pneumatic air pressure for safe, gradual extension.
EXTENDED FOREARM STABILITY: Provides reinforced lateral support for proper alignment and posture.
THERAPEUTIC POSITIONING: Designed for wrist flexion synergy and neurological hand contracture therapy.
COMFORTABLE FIT SYSTEM: Soft straps and foam-lined support ensure secure, skin-safe application.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Fisted hand due to neurological conditions
